chain.title: Luck of the Meadow
chain.desc: Break the low clover ground cover that carpets the Clover Patch, Orchard and Mystic Grove biomes.

chain.title: Prairie Gold
chain.desc: Pick goldenrod from open Prairie biomes; each stalk crafts into two yellow dye.

chain.title: The Purple Horizon
chain.desc: Harvest lavender from the Lavender Field and Lavender Forest biomes; one bloom crafts into purple dye.

chain.title: Reeds of the Standing Water
chain.desc: Cut cattails from the shallows of Wetland and Bayou biomes; each crafts into two brown dye.

chain.title: A Handful of Grain
chain.desc: Gather wild barley from the tall grass of Pasture and Seasonal Orchard biomes.

chain.title: Speckled Cap
chain.desc: Collect toadstools from Coniferous Forest, Wetland, Fungal Jungle and Pumpkin Patch floors; one can replace the mushroom in rabbit stew.

chain.title: Timber of the Cold Slopes
chain.desc: Fell the tall fir trees that fill Coniferous Forest, Fir Clearing and Snowy Coniferous Forest biomes.

chain.title: Roots in Black Water
chain.desc: Chop willow trees standing in the flooded Bayou and Wetland biomes.

chain.title: Bleached Shore
chain.desc: Shovel white sand from the disks that generate in Mystic Grove and Tropics biomes.

chain.title: Ash on the Beach
chain.desc: Dig black sand from the disks that generate around Volcanic Plains and Volcano biomes.

chain.title: Wood That Hums
chain.desc: Fell the pale magic trees that grow only in the Mystic Grove biome.

chain.title: Lanterns Underfoot
chain.desc: Pick glowshrooms from the cave floor of the underground Glowing Grotto biome.

chain.title: The Grotto Breathes Light
chain.desc: Mine the glowing moss blocks that pave the Glowing Grotto's vegetation layer.

chain.title: Threads That Shine
chain.desc: Shear the hanging glowworm silk strands from the ceilings of the Glowing Grotto.

chain.title: Do Not Wake Them
chain.desc: Mine a spider egg with a Silk Touch tool inside the Spider Nest biome.

chain.title: Cut the Threads
chain.desc: Shear stringy cobweb from the choked passages of the Spider Nest biome.

chain.title: Pink Fracture
chain.desc: Break a rose quartz cluster in the Crystalline Chasm with a pickaxe to shed two chunks, more with Fortune.

chain.title: Compressed Blush
chain.desc: Craft four rose quartz chunks in a square; rose quartz also serves as an armor trim material.

chain.title: The Inferno Erupts
chain.desc: Mine brimstone from the Erupting Inferno biome in the Nether; four blocks craft into brimstone bricks.

chain.title: The Ground Is Alive
chain.desc: Mine the flesh terrain that makes up the Visceral Heap biome in the Nether.

chain.title: Draw From the Lake
chain.desc: Fill an empty bucket from the blood lakes and springs that pool across the Visceral Heap.

chain.title: Bark of the Scorched
chain.desc: Fell the blackened hellbark trees that grow in the Undergrowth biome.

chain.title: Where It All Began
chain.desc: Break the leaves of an origin tree in the rare Origin Valley biome to drop its sapling.

chain.title: Every Corner of the World
chain.desc: Awarded by the mod's all_biomes challenge advancement, which requires standing in all sixty-four Biomes O' Plenty biomes.

notes: Item set = 349 ids from assets/biomesoplenty/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys in assets/*/lang/en_us.json. Every id above is set-membership verified against that intersection. Biome attributions were resolved by walking data/biomesoplenty/worldgen/configured_feature -> placed_feature -> biome; dye recipes, the rose_quartz_cluster loot table (2 chunks with Fortune ore_drops), the rose_quartz_block and brimstone_bricks recipes, the shears-gated loot tables (glowworm_silk, stringy_cobweb, flesh_tendons, hair), the Silk Touch-gated loot tables (spider_egg, brimstone_cluster, eyebulb, pus_bubble, buds), the rabbit_stew_from_toadstool recipe and data/biomesoplenty/loot_tables/advancements/all_biomes.json (which awards music_disc_wanderer) were all read from the jar. DROPPED: biomesoplenty:dried_salt - the item verifies, but the jar contains no worldgen feature or recipe for it (only a pickaxe tag and its block loot table), so no factual acquisition sentence could be written. No kill: entries - the only entity lang keys in the jar are entity.biomesoplenty.boat and entity.biomesoplenty.chest_boat, which are vehicles, not mobs. No dim: entries - the jar contains no data/biomesoplenty/dimension/ files; BoP adds 64 overworld/Nether biomes, not dimensions. bop_icon was excluded as a creative-tab placeholder. Only one representative log per wood line is used, and saplings are deliberately not enumerated per biome.
